_notes: Main-server configuration for Structure Controller, CurseForge mod 1470304.
The intended item-specific limits are two Seed Farm Ultimate Tek Plots, 50 Seed Farm Tek Crop Plots, and one Cyber Structures Tek Forcefield per tribe per map.
The server owner reports that the configuration works on the test server. This file preserves the current test configuration's effective settings, including the owner's Ultimate Tek Plot limit of 2.
MaxStructuresPerTribe=2000000000 is a finite high-cap workaround for a zero-limit bug found by static inspection of mod file 7842511. It is not literal unlimited.
Other custom structure settings are empty; the connected-structure cap and optional limit UI/command are disabled.
The inspected mod contacts an external verification service before applying settings. No credentials are included.
In GameUserSettings.ini use [StructureController] JsonSource=raw.githubusercontent.com/troubledtribblejt-commits/structurelimits/main/structure-limits.json without the https:// prefix.
Existing excess structures are not automatically removed by the inspected placement check. The inspected mod has no admin exemption for per-item limits.
structure-limits-test.json remains a separate file for testing. Changes to that file do not alter this file's settings.
